submitted.rationale: Measured EQE at Sb fractions 0.264, 0.33, 0.362, 0.502 and 0.657. It peaked at index 3 (Sb=0.33, 0.0368%), and index 4 was close behind (0.0309%). EQE falls off sharply on both sides: toward the Pb2Sb2O7 (0.5) and PbSb2O6 (0.667) compositions, and toward Pb-rich 0.26. Pb-rich pyrochlore-type Pb2Sb2O7 has a predicted HSE gap of about 2.5 eV, which the 2.7 eV light can excite. It is the likely absorber, probably mixed with a PbOx secondary phase near Sb≈0.33.

rejected.reason: PbSb2O6 region; gap ~2.69 eV at the edge of the 2.7 eV photons; measured EQE 0.00025%
